versions.changelog: v1.0.2 — production license-key prefix wired in. Buyers from Gumroad can now unlock the novelty subcommand by setting EDGAR_RISK_LICENSE or writing the key to ~/.edgar-risk-diff/license.txt.
v1.0.1 — cleanup: remove operator setup docs from public bundle. No behavior changes.

v1.0.0 — initial release. Diffs Item 1A (Risk Factors) between two 10-Ks for any US-listed ticker. Theme tags, churn %, multi-ticker scan. EDGAR direct, no API key. Premium tier adds embedding-based novelty scoring.
